objectives.label: Ali je vaš pes prijazen? Ali se lahko povohata?
objectives.descriptorEN: Ask about another dog before the dogs meet.

objectives.label: Ja, ampak še mladiček je.
objectives.descriptorEN: Answer honestly about your own dog.

objectives.label: Potem pa raje ne. Gremo naprej.
objectives.descriptorEN: Back off politely when a meeting isn't a good idea.

objectives.label: Tega lahko …, tistega pa ne.
objectives.descriptorEN: Offer one dog and keep the other back.

objectives.label: Samo igrati se hoče.
objectives.descriptorEN: Explain your puppy's wildness and hold him.

n1.speaker: npc
n1.sl: Dober dan. Oho, kako se gledajo.
n1.en: Good day. Oh, look at them eyeing each other.
n1.deliverySL: [warmly] Dober dan. Oho, kako se gledajo.

c1a.speaker: client
c1a.sl: Dober dan. Ali je vaš pes prijazen?
c1a.en: Good day. Is your dog friendly?
c1a.deliverySL: [warmly] Dober dan. Ali je vaš pes prijazen?

c1b.speaker: client
c1b.sl: Dober dan. Ali se lahko povohata?
c1b.en: Good day. Can they sniff each other?
c1b.deliverySL: [warmly] Dober dan. Ali se lahko povohata?

c1c.speaker: client
c1c.en: Good day. Sorry, we're moving on.

nDecl.speaker: npc
nDecl.sl: Ni problema, midve greva kar na drugo stran. Adijo!
nDecl.en: No problem, the two of us will just take the other side. Bye!
nDecl.deliverySL: [warmly] Ni problema, midve greva kar na drugo stran. Adijo!

n2b.speaker: npc
n2b.sl: Najprej mi povejte, a je vaš prijazen?
n2b.en: First tell me, is yours friendly?
n2b.deliverySL: [warmly] Najprej mi povejte, a je vaš prijazen?

c2ok.speaker: client
c2ok.en: Yes, but he's still a puppy.

c2old.speaker: client
c2old.en: Yes, but he's still a puppy.
c2old.context: her dog is old and shy

c2no.speaker: client
c2no.en: Yes, but he's still a puppy.
c2no.context: her dog doesn't like other dogs

n3ok.speaker: npc
n3ok.sl: Ja, tudi moja je prijazna. Kar naj se povohata.
n3ok.en: Yes, mine's friendly too. Let them have a sniff.
n3ok.deliverySL: [warmly] Ja, tudi moja je prijazna. Kar naj se povohata.

c3play.speaker: client
c3play.context: the dogs sniff and play nicely

c3wild.speaker: client
c3wild.context: enzo jumps all over her dog

n4play.speaker: npc
n4play.sl: Glejte, že se igrata. Kaj pa ta?
n4play.en: Look, they're already playing. And that one?
n4play.deliverySL: [warmly] Glejte, že se igrata. Kaj pa ta?

c4d1.speaker: client
c4d1.sl: Ta je danes miren. Lahko se povohata.
c4d1.en: This one is calm today. They can sniff each other.
c4d1.deliverySL: [warmly] Ta je danes miren. Lahko se povohata.

c4d2.speaker: client
c4d2.sl: Tega raje ne. Včasih je nervozen ob drugih psih.
c4d2.en: Better not this one. He's sometimes nervous around other dogs.
c4d2.deliverySL: [warmly] Tega raje ne. Včasih je nervozen ob drugih psih.

n5dYes.speaker: npc
n5dYes.sl: Kako lepo, vsi trije se razumejo.
n5dYes.en: How lovely, all three get along.
n5dYes.deliverySL: [cheerfully] Kako lepo, vsi trije se razumejo.

n5dNo.speaker: npc
n5dNo.sl: Seveda, saj ni treba. Ta dva se itak igrata.
n5dNo.en: Of course, no need. Those two are playing anyway.
n5dNo.deliverySL: [warmly] Seveda, saj ni treba. Ta dva se itak igrata.

n4wild.speaker: npc
n4wild.sl: Joj! Malo preveč živahen je zanjo.
n4wild.en: Oh dear! He's a bit too lively for her.
n4wild.deliverySL: [hesitantly] Joj! Malo preveč živahen je zanjo.

c4w2.speaker: client
c4w2.sl: Samo igrati se hoče. Držim ga.
c4w2.en: He just wants to play. I'm holding him.
c4w2.deliverySL: [warmly] Samo igrati se hoče. Držim ga.

nWildBye.speaker: npc
nWildBye.sl: Nič hudega, saj je še mlad. Adijo!
nWildBye.en: No harm done, he's only young. Bye!
nWildBye.deliverySL: [warmly] Nič hudega, saj je še mlad. Adijo!

n5hold.speaker: npc
n5hold.sl: Saj vem, mladički so taki. Hvala, ker ga držite. Adijo!
n5hold.en: I know, puppies are like that. Thanks for holding him. Bye!
n5hold.deliverySL: [warmly] Saj vem, mladički so taki. Hvala, ker ga držite. Adijo!

n3old.speaker: npc
n3old.sl: Oh, moja je pa že stara. Malo je plašna.
n3old.en: Oh, mine's old already. She's a bit shy.
n3old.deliverySL: [hesitantly] Oh, moja je pa že stara. Malo je plašna.

n3no.speaker: npc
n3no.sl: Moja žal ne mara drugih psov.
n3no.en: Mine doesn't like other dogs, I'm afraid.
n3no.deliverySL: [hesitantly] Moja žal ne mara drugih psov.

cRaje.speaker: client
cRaje.sl: Potem pa raje ne. Gremo naprej.
cRaje.en: Then better not. We'll move on.
cRaje.deliverySL: [warmly] Potem pa raje ne. Gremo naprej.

c3oDen.speaker: client
c3oDen.sl: Tega lahko povoha, tistega pa ne. Ta je miren.
c3oDen.en: She can sniff this one, but not that one. This one's calm.
c3oDen.deliverySL: [warmly] Tega lahko povoha, tistega pa ne. Ta je miren.

c3nDen.speaker: client
c3nDen.sl: Tega lahko povoha, tistega pa ne. Ta je miren.
c3nDen.en: She can sniff this one, but not that one. This one's calm.
c3nDen.deliverySL: [warmly] Tega lahko povoha, tistega pa ne. Ta je miren.

n4oDen.speaker: npc
n4oDen.sl: Ja, z mirnim bo v redu. Glejte, kako lepo se vohata.
n4oDen.en: Yes, a calm one will be fine. Look how nicely they're sniffing.
n4oDen.deliverySL: [warmly] Ja, z mirnim bo v redu. Glejte, kako lepo se vohata.

n4nDen.speaker: npc
n4nDen.sl: Oh, oprostite, tudi mirnih ne mara. Raje ne.
n4nDen.en: Oh, sorry, she doesn't like calm ones either. Better not.
n4nDen.deliverySL: [sheepishly] Oh, oprostite, tudi mirnih ne mara. Raje ne.

nByeNo.speaker: npc
nByeNo.sl: Hvala za razumevanje. Pa lep sprehod!
nByeNo.en: Thanks for understanding. Have a nice walk!
nByeNo.deliverySL: [warmly] Hvala za razumevanje. Pa lep sprehod!

nBye.speaker: npc
nBye.sl: Adijo! Še kaj pridite, bo vesela.
nBye.en: Bye! Come by again, she'll be glad.
nBye.deliverySL: [warmly] Adijo! Še kaj pridite, bo vesela.
